newsitem.title: USA: Hinsdale defends merger, attacks opponent.
newsitem.headline: Hinsdale defends merger, attacks opponent.

text.p: Hinsdale Financial Corp directors, in a letter to shareholders, defended the company's proposed merger with Liberty Bancorp Inc and attacked a partnership that opposes the deal.
Hinsdale Chairman William Rybak wrote that the company believes the merger would be in the best interests of Hinsdale and its shareholders.

He sharply criticizes TGF Investments LP, a Delaware limited partnership that opposes the merger. "We believe TGF has disseminated inaccurate and even misleading information in an effort to derail the merger," he said.
